description: This file defines an enumeration 'FilterFunctions' that implements the 'FilterFunction' interface, serving as a factory for supported filter functions such as 'eq', 'ne', and 'like'. It provides methods to retrieve functions by name and to apply these functions with parameters.

classes.name: FilterFunctions
classes.description: An enum implementing FilterFunction, providing support for 'eq', 'ne', and 'like' filter functions, along with utility methods for function retrieval.

methods.name: fromName
methods.description: Static method that returns an Optional containing a FilterFunction implementation matching the provided name, or empty if not found.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the filter function.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies the filter function with provided parameters, returning a boolean indicating success or failure.
